name: OscString
summary: A plucked string (Karplus-Strong), the first audio-rate module.
author: Animatek
about: A plucked string, with the Karplus-Strong method, after the G2's. A delay line as long as the note's period feeds back on itself through a lowpass (Damp) and a gain (Decay). A rising edge at Trig plucks it, putting a period of noise into the line. Exc adds any signal into it.
It is the first audio-rate module in G1-Mods. Note and Pitch set the string's note.
usage: Send a gate to Trig and a pitch to Pitch (a keyboard's Note out): a plucked note on every key.
Plug another oscillator or noise into Exc to excite the string with your own sound.
Lower Damp for a duller string, raise Decay for a longer ring.
notes: The lowest note is about 94 Hz, from a line of 1,024 words. Lower would need the line run at half or a quarter of the rate. Javier played it on 17 Oct 2026: it works. It is the biggest code in G1-Mods.

patch_notes.string.pch: A pluck triggers the Karplus-Strong string, set by its note.
